universal_lens: Expected possession value (EPV) models quantify goal-scoring probability via tactical features and spatial positioning, enabling explainable AI for attacking success in soccer. Expected Possession Value (EPV) integrates spatial control, defensive pressure, and pass reception probability to quantify attacking success in soccer.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference maps EPV predictions to player decision-making confidence using probabilistic belief updates over match states. GSI employs Bayesian inference to map EPV features into probabilistic scoring likelihoods using conformal prediction for real-time tactical assessment.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning encodes EPV-derived state transitions through player actions, capturing dynamic tactical evolution across match segments. GSE utilizes EPV-derived state transitions to model offensive play dynamics, enabling situational reasoning about pass options and goal-scoring probabilities.
